transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I need to get the seven-day duty board finalized and signed for 17 June through 23 June. We've got four posts to fill: access-control supervisor, vehicle-dispatch desk, communications key-control desk, and clinic liaison post. Before I sign, I need each of you to confirm qualification and availability for your respective area's primary. Let's go around the room — personnel, motor pool, signal, and medical reps, what do you have for me?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, before you sign, I need to flag something on the access-control supervisor post. The updated certification roster I received this morning shows Sgt. Hall as the only person whose access-control-supervisor certification remains valid through 23 June. That update has not yet been added to the duty-board working copy, so if the working copy shows anyone else as primary for that post, they may not actually be qualified for the full period.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, for the vehicle-dispatch desk post, I need to flag that Cpl. Vega is the only available person in the company with the current vehicle-dispatch qualification for 17-23 June. I confirmed the qualification against the motor-pool register today, but the register update is still awaiting the weekly personnel upload, so the working copy may not reflect this yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, for the communications key-control desk, I need to flag that Spc. Noor is the only current encryption-key custodian available for the entire 17-23 June period. I verified the custodian appointment with the communications security clerk this morning, but the appointment has not been posted to the company duty board, so the working copy may not reflect this yet.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Capt. Morgan, for the clinic liaison post, I need to flag that Sgt. Ellis completed the required medical-privacy liaison training and is the only available person cleared to serve as the clinic liaison throughout 17-23 June. I also received the clinic training sign-off after the last staff meeting, so my qualification is not on the circulated qualification list — but Sgt. Ellis is the one who should be primary for this period.
transcript.speaker: A5
